examples.label: People with their role
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-table" site="Global" id="people-table" rows={[%{name: "Ada Lovelace", role: "Engineer"}, %{name: "Grace Hopper", role: "Admiral"}, %{name: "Alan Turing", role: "Researcher"}]} class="w-full max-w-xl text-left text-sm" head_class="border-b border-current/15" header_class="px-3 py-2 font-medium" body_class="divide-y divide-current/10" cell_class="px-3 py-2"><:col :let={person} label="Name">{person.name}</:col><:col :let={person} label="Role">{person.role}</:col></.component>

examples.label: Team with a caption and no members yet
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-table" site="Global" id="empty-table" rows={[]} caption="Team" show_caption caption_class="pb-2 text-left font-medium" class="w-full max-w-xl text-left text-sm" head_class="border-b border-current/15" header_class="px-3 py-2 font-medium" body_class="divide-y divide-current/10" cell_class="px-3 py-2" empty_class="px-3 py-6 text-center opacity-70"><:col label="Name"></:col><:col label="Role"></:col><:empty>Nobody here yet.</:empty></.component>
